notes.title: Ball Pain 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8xjsVz8CYmo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]UNLOCKABLE SKINS ![/b][/h3]

The player can now unlock 7 new skins by completing stages of the game, once unlocked they can be selected via a new button on the pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012355/da9c704809c8ef511079ee713c61ca82f0d2fe42.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3][/b]

- The Ball is now bouncier and has less friction making the gameplay even more challenging.

- I tweaked the level to fix a few colliders and also added some more obstacles to stop people leaping past some challenges.
